summary: Facade lacks substance or exports mutable state
title: Facade lacks substance or exports mutable state
description: Facades and gateways must carry ELOC >= 15 or Object.freeze immutability guards across >= 3 orthogonal subdomains.
rationale: Empty forwarding trampolines add cognitive hops (HopPenalty = +3.0) and obscure stack traces.
remediation: Add input contract validation + Object.freeze() or dissolve trampolines directly to the underlying service.
